name: VOZHD CHETIRI — COMPILER & PERSISTENCE ARCHITECTURE
governing_question: Is persistent event-grain empirical materialization architecturally necessary, or a regenerable compiler intermediate between immutable source evidence and the permanent compiled structural substrate consumed by V3?

C01.name: TERMINAL_PRODUCT_AND_V3_CONSUMPTION_AUDIT
C01.burden: Trace runtime consumption backward and classify every upstream product by persistence necessity.

C02.name: C11_DERIVABILITY_AND_MINIMUM_PERSISTENT_STATE_COURT
C02.burden: Classify every logically observable C11 obligation by exact determinant and persistence requirement.

C03.name: NATIVE_SOURCE_EXECUTION_CAPABILITY_RECONNAISSANCE
C03.burden: Measure real SAV/DTA access capabilities and incompatibilities without semantic redesign.

C04.name: I03_SOURCE_BACKED_EXECUTION_COURT
C04.burden: Prove or falsify exact I03 primitive execution over source-backed logical C11.

C05.name: I05_SOURCE_BACKED_DISCOVERY_COURT
C05.burden: Prove or falsify open-world bounded discovery without mandatory authoritative full event materialization.

C06.name: REPLAY_EXACTREF_AND_INTEGRITY_COURT
C06.burden: Determine the minimum persistent receipts/roots needed for exact replay, identity and fail-closed integrity.

C07.name: COMPILED_STRUCTURAL_SUBSTRATE_AND_BUILD_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY
C07.burden: Define what permanent V3-facing compiled products must be made maximally clean, light, fast and effective.

C08.name: INCREMENTAL_BUILD_UPDATE_AND_OPERATIONS_COURT
C08.burden: Determine rebuild granularity, invalidation, recovery and operational cost under each candidate family.

C09.name: EXACT_PHYSICAL_BAKEOFF
C09.burden: Measure A/B/C on identical representative compiler primitives after semantic contracts are frozen.

C10.name: HOSTILE_SYNTHESIS_KILL_COURT
C10.burden: Attack the provisional winner and seek a decisive falsification or unresolved hidden dependency.
